Two knobs decide how big a convolution's.zh: 有两个旋钮决定卷积输出的尺寸。@@T0@@填充@@T1@@ 添加一圈零作为边界，使边缘像素得到公平的机会 —— 并且可以让输出尺寸保持不变。@@T2@@步幅@@T3@@ 让卷积核跳跃而非爬行，从而有意地缩小输出。移动四个滑块，一条取整公式便能在卷积核迈出第一步之前告诉你输出尺寸。
Two knobs decide how big a convolution's.src: Two knobs decide how big a convolution's output is. Padding adds a border of zeros so edge pixels get a fair turn — and can hold the output size fixed. Stride makes the kernel jump instead of creep, shrinking the output on purpose. Move the four sliders and one floor formula tells you the output size before the kernel has taken a single step.

@@T0@@~7 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 7 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · CNN · 卷积算术@@T3@@

Four sliders, one output size.zh: 四个滑块，一个输出尺寸

The grey grid is a $W\\times W$ input. P.zh: 灰色网格是一个 $W\times W$ 的输入。填充将其包裹在一圈虚线零单元组成的边界中。随后一个 $K\times K$ 的卷积核以步幅 $S$ 在填充后的网格上滑动，每落一次对应一个输出单元。逐步走过每次落位，观察右侧的输出网格恰好增长到公式所预测的尺寸。
The grey grid is a $W\\times W$ input. P.src:
The grey grid is a $W\times W$ input. Padding wraps it in a border of dashed
      zero cells. A $K\times K$ kernel then slides across the padded grid with stride
      $S$, landing once per output cell. Step through the landings and watch the output
      grid on the right grow to exactly the size the formula predicts.

Left: the input (solid) wrapped in a pad.zh: 左侧：输入（实线）被一圈填充的零（虚线）包裹。卷积核轮廓即当前窗口。右侧：输出网格，随卷积核落位而逐渐填入。
Left: the input (solid) wrapped in a pad.src: Left: the input (solid) wrapped in a padded border of zeros (dashed). The kernel outline is the current window. Right: the output grid, filling in as the kernel lands.

@@T0@@Try the two buttons.@@T1@@ \"Make.zh: @@T0@@试试这两个按钮。@@T1@@ 「设为 valid」令 $P=0$：由于卷积核绝不能悬出边界，输出严格小于输入。「设为 same」在 $S=1$ 时令 $P=\tfrac{K-1}{2}$：这一填充边界恰好足够宽，使输出与输入相同。随后把步幅提到 $2$，无论是否填充，输出都会减半。
@@T0@@Try the two buttons.@@T1@@ \"Make.src: Try the two buttons. "Make it valid" sets $P=0$: the output is strictly smaller than the input because the kernel can never hang off the edge. "Make it same" sets $P=\tfrac{K-1}{2}$ with $S=1$: the padded border is exactly wide enough that the output matches the input. Then bump the stride to $2$ and watch the output halve, padding or not.

@@T0@@$W + 2P$@@T1@@ is the padded width.zh: @@T0@@$W + 2P$@@T1@@ 是填充后的宽度 —— 填充在 @@T2@@每@@T3@@ 一侧各加入 $P$ 个单元，因此有系数 2。
@@T0@@$W + 2P$@@T1@@ is the padded width.src: $W + 2P$ is the padded width — padding adds $P$ cells on each side, hence the factor of two.

@@T0@@$-K$@@T1@@ accounts for the kernel.zh: @@T0@@$-K$@@T1@@ 源于卷积核在其远端边缘落到网格之外前需要占据 $K$ 个单元；$W+2P-K$ 是最后一个合法的起始列。
@@T0@@$-K$@@T1@@ accounts for the kernel.src: $-K$ accounts for the kernel needing $K$ cells under it before the far edge falls off the grid; $W+2P-K$ is the last valid starting column.

@@T0@@$\\div S$ then $+1$@@T1@@ counts t.zh: @@T0@@$\div S$ 然后 $+1$@@T1@@ 统计落位次数：从 $0$ 开始，每次跳 $S$，再为起始位置本身加上一。
@@T0@@$\\div S$ then $+1$@@T1@@ counts t.src: $\div S$ then $+1$ counts the landings: start at $0$, jump by $S$, and add one for the starting position itself.

@@T0@@The floor@@T1@@ means a stride tha.zh: @@T0@@取整（floor）@@T1@@ 意味着不能整除空间的步幅只会丢弃边缘处剩余的单元 —— 卷积核绝不会悬空一半。
@@T0@@The floor@@T1@@ means a stride tha.src: The floor means a stride that does not divide the space evenly simply drops the leftover cells at the edge — the kernel never half-hangs off.

@@T0@@\"Same\" padding, precisely.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@精确地说，「same」填充。@@T1@@ 在步幅为 $1$ 时，当 $2P = K-1$，即 $P=\tfrac{K-1}{2}$ 时，输出等于输入。这正是奇数卷积核尺寸（$3,5,7$）成为惯例的原因：只有此时 $\tfrac{K-1}{2}$ 才是整数，填充也才是对称的。正是这一技巧让深度 CNN 能够堆叠数十个 $3\times3$ 层而不使特征图坍缩殆尽。
@@T0@@\"Same\" padding, precisely.@@T1@@.src: "Same" padding, precisely. With stride $1$, output equals input when $2P = K-1$, i.e. $P=\tfrac{K-1}{2}$. That is why odd kernel sizes ($3,5,7$) are the norm: only then is $\tfrac{K-1}{2}$ a whole number and the padding is symmetric. This is the trick that lets deep CNNs stack dozens of $3\times3$ layers without the feature map collapsing to nothing.

meta.title: 填充、步幅与输出尺寸
meta.tagline: 移动四个滑块，看一条取整公式如何精确预测卷积的输出尺寸
meta.summary: 一个输入网格被一圈虚线填充零所包裹，一个卷积核以选定的步幅在其上滑动。输入尺寸 W、卷积核 K、填充 P 与步幅 S 的滑块驱动这段动画，输出网格每落位一次就增长一格，直到达到 floor((W+2P-K)/S)+1 所预测的尺寸。一键按钮可切换到 same 填充（输出等于输入）与 valid 填充（P=0），并有一个实时标签标明当前模式，让这套几何不再是需要死记的东西。
highlights: 观察填充的零单元被绘成围绕真实输入的一圈独特的虚线边界。
步进或播放卷积核扫过每一个合法位置，观察输出网格逐步填入。
当你移动四个滑块中的任意一个时，直接从 floor((W+2P-K)/S)+1 读出输出尺寸。
一键将填充切换为 same（输出等于输入）或 valid（P=0），并配有实时的模式标签。
把步幅提到 2，观察输出减半，让「用步幅做下采样」变得具体。
